_readme: DEMO DATASET — NOT A LIVE REGISTRY FEED.
FSSAI (FoSCoS) and BIS do not publish a clean, key-free public lookup API, so this
MVP ships a small hardcoded sample file. Every entry below is an ILLUSTRATIVE demo
record created for this hackathon build to exercise the lookup path end to end.
IMPORTANT HONESTY NOTE: the spec asked for 'real, manually-verified' numbers. The
sandbox in which this MVP was built has no network access to fssai.gov.in / FoSCoS,
so no entry here could actually be verified against the registry. They are therefore
labelled demo records and must NOT be presented as verified. Before any public use,
replace this file (or the lookup function) with a live FoSCoS query, or seed it only
with numbers a human has checked on https://foscos.fssai.gov.in and delete this note.
Lookup rule used by the app: a 14-digit number read off the label that is NOT in this
file returns 'not in demo dataset — cannot verify'. It is never reported as invalid.
source: Demo dataset — production version integrates live registries (FSSAI FoSCoS)
